caption: The drawing depicts two gray panther-like animals standing side by side, each with their mouths open displaying teeth and red tongues. Both animals are harnessed together with a pair of brown saddles, which are decorated with gold trim, and are connected by a curved, ornate wooden yoke resting on their backs. The composition is simple, with the animals centered on a plain, off-white background, and there are no additional objects or scenery present. The colors primarily used are shades of gray for the animals, brown and gold for the harnesses and yoke, and reddish accents for the interiors of the animals' mouths.
title: Carousel Panthers
